scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text:
Making a living through business ain't easy.
I get real bad motion sickness, yet today I got caught up in a storm on my way here.

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text: It was such a horrible experience. Thanks to that, I don't feel so good. Ughh...

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text:
Anyway, did you come here looking for a Cute Pet?
You've brought a ticket with you, right?

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text: I don't think you've got the stuff I want.

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text: Which ticket do you want to exchange?

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text:
Great!
^0000FF{0}^000000
Are you sure you want this pet?

You're carrying too much stuff!
Come back when you've made some space.

scripts.speaker: Pet Trader
scripts.text: So you want hear about the land across the sea, but I ain't feeling so well today.
